name: codex-orchestrator
description: General-purpose Dual-Brain orchestration plugin for Antigravity CLI (agy) & App: Gemini plans, freezes research/data corpora, orchestrates Codex CLI (or codex-worker) across coding (/impl, /review, /dag) and research/red-team/analysis (/research, /debate, /analyze) with strict JSON schemas, layered verification, and clear Chinese briefs.
suggestedPrompts: /impl Explore the codebase, write a Spec, delegate implementation to Codex CLI, verify, and brief me clearly
/review Run a single-pass structured Codex CLI review on uncommitted changes and explain key risks in Chinese
/dag Lock a shared contract, run parallel managed-worktree Codex workers, check merge conflicts, and brief me
/research Freeze a source corpus, run parallel Codex research + blind critique, spot-check citations, and brief me
/debate Run a blind red-team Codex critique on this proposal, adjudicate P0/P1 challenges, and give a decision matrix
/analyze Cross-check paper/theory, code, and experiment metrics with Codex analyze mode and highlight discrepancies
